title: WebSocket Chat Interface for AI OSCE Sessions
description: Real-time chat interface enabling medical students to practice communication skills and clinical reasoning with AI patients

phase.name: Frontend Core
phase.description: Foundational user interface components for OSCE practice platform

acceptance_criteria: WebSocket connection established on component mount with auto-reconnect on failure
Users can send messages via input field with Enter key or Send button
AI patient responses displayed in real-time with typing indicators
Message history scrolls automatically to latest message
Connection status indicator shows online/offline/reconnecting states
All UI components follow Material-UI design system and theme
TypeScript compilation succeeds with 0 errors (npx tsc --noEmit)
All tests pass with 100% pass rate and ≥80% code coverage
No hardcoded credentials, URLs, or secrets in code (verified by grep)
WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility compliance (keyboard navigation, screen reader support)
Performance benchmarks met: <500ms latency, 60fps scrolling, <100ms render
Error handling for all edge cases (connection loss, failed messages, offline mode)
Australian medical terminology used throughout (paracetamol not acetaminophen)
Component integrates with existing irStudy platform routing and authentication
Documentation complete with inline comments and usage examples

validations.description: TypeScript compilation must succeed with 0 errors
All unit and integration tests must pass
No hardcoded credentials or URLs in code

validations.command: cd /home/dev/Development/irStudy/frontend && npx playwright test a11y --grep OSCEChatInterface
cd /home/dev/Development/irStudy/frontend && npx playwright test performance --grep OSCEChatInterface
cd /home/dev/Development/irStudy/frontend && npx playwright test e2e --grep OSCEChatInterface

architecture: WebSocket connection managed via useEffect hook
Message state managed with useState and useRef
Material-UI components for UI (Box, Typography, TextField, Button, Paper)
Auto-scroll to latest message using useRef and scrollIntoView
Environment variables for WebSocket URL configuration

api_endpoints.description: WebSocket endpoint for OSCE chat sessions (upgrade HTTP to WebSocket)
Create new OSCE session with persona_code
Get OSCE session details and message history
